test_freq_setter_errors: test the DatetimeIndex.freq setter raises ValueError for incompatible or invalid frequency strings
test_freq_setter: test the DatetimeIndex.freq setter accepts string offsets, DateOffset objects, and various timezones
test_freq_view_safe: test that setting freq on one DatetimeIndex does not affect another DatetimeIndex viewing the same data
test_freq_reset_to_none: test that the DatetimeIndex.freq setter can be reset to None
test_freq_with_business_days: test the DatetimeIndex.freq setter with business day offsets like BDay and 2B
